title: [P2] Provide a declarative time-relative trigger (avoid fragile date-equality on record-change)
body:
## Problem
Time-relative business rules ("alert N days before a date") can only be expressed today as a `record_change` flow with a fragile date-equality condition like `end_date == daysFromNow(60)` — which only fires if the record happens to be updated on that exact day. The robust alternative is a hand-written cron + range query.

## Repro
contracts `renewal_alert` (T-60/30/7), `renewal_draft`, hr `document_expiring_soon`, procurement `po_overdue` — all use date-equality on record-change and therefore don't fire unattended.

## Expected
A declarative time-relative trigger (e.g. "fire daily for records where `end_date` is within N days") so authors don't reimplement cron+query each time.

## Affected
`@objectstack/plugin-trigger-schedule`.


---
_Found while runtime-testing `objectstack-ai/templates` (all 9 templates via `objectstack dev all`) on `@objectstack` 9.5.1. Build + typecheck pass; these only surface at runtime._
